description:
Clipious is a client for Invidious, the privacy focused YouTube front end.
Features:
• Use own or public server
• Subscription management
• SponsorBlock + DeArrow
• Video view/progress tracking
• User playlists
• Background playback
• Live stream support
• Android TV UI
• Audio playback
• Video and audio download
• Video filtering
• Return Youtube Dislikes
